A model of dismissal risk, not a prediction.

short.vo: Fifteen overs left. New Zealand two thirty-nine for five. India needed five wickets, and शुभमन गिल shook hands. Too soon? We simulated the last fifteen overs, a hundred thousand times.

scene.title: Too soon?
scene.name: THE HANDSHAKE
scene.mono: WE SIMULATED THE LAST 15 OVERS 100,000 TIMES
scene.caption: Did Shubman Gill quit too soon?

short.vo: Ninety balls. Five wickets. And all day, India had taken one wicket every twenty-five overs.

head.sub: NEW ZEALAND 239/5 · ABOUT AN HOUR LEFT

tiles.l: INDIA'S WICKETS PER OVERS ALL DAY

short.vo: The model: how often batters get out in nine hundred Tests, calibrated to this pitch, where Day five's batters got out two point four times less often than the archive says.

items.d: 899 men's Tests: how often a batter is out, by balls faced
Day 5's batters got out 2.4 times less often than the archive says: 3 dismissals, 7.1 expected
ball by ball, from Mitchell and Phillips at the crease

short.vo: In fifty-six per cent of the simulations, India took no wicket at all. Just one in two hundred and seventy took all five.

head.sub: SHARE OF 100,000 SIMULATED FINISHES · THIS PITCH

short.vo: On an average Test pitch, the same finish comes up eight per cent of the time. This pitch made it four in a thousand.

head.sub: CHANCE OF AN INDIA WIN · SIMULATED

short.vo: To make it a one in twenty chance, India would have had to take wickets twice as fast as they had all day.

head.sub: CHANCE OF A WIN IF INDIA TOOK WICKETS FASTER · 15 OVERS

short.vo: More overs would have helped. Another ten, two per cent. Another twenty-five, one in ten.

head.sub: CHANCE OF A WIN IF THE DAY HAD LASTED LONGER · THIS PITCH

short.vo: The match was lost earlier. A run-out आकाश दीप missed. A bat-pad off प्रसिद्ध, with no short leg. A kicker पडिक्कल could not hold. All three were Mitchell.

head.sub: CHANCE OF AN INDIA WIN, BEFORE AND IF TAKEN

short.vo: Each was worth between seventeen and twenty-two points of win probability. In WTC points, the last fifteen overs were worth three hundredths of a point. Each chance, up to one point eight.

head.sub: EIGHT POINTS BETWEEN A WIN AND A DRAW · EXPECTED GAIN

short.vo: Did the pitch die at the end? No. Edges and misses per hundred balls: twelve before lunch, seventeen after, eight in the evening, eleven in the last fifteen overs.

head.sub: EDGES AND PLAY-AND-MISSES PER 100 BALLS · OUR COUNT

short.vo: And the ground is no freak. In our archive, the Basin Reserve takes wickets in the last two innings at nine point four per hundred overs, the same as the rest of New Zealand. Day five managed four.

head.sub: WICKETS PER 100 OVERS IN INNINGS 3 AND 4 · IN OUR ARCHIVE

short.vo: The last fifteen overs: वॉशिंगटन सुंदर six, आकाश दीप, बुमराह and प्रसिद्ध two each, then जायसवाल and Jurel. बुमराह's last over was the hundred and tenth.
गिल said after the match that getting ten wickets on that wicket was always going to be a challenge, but that India had a couple of chances.

scene.sub: “We knew it's gonna be a challenge to get ten wickets on that wicket. But we had our chances, couple of chances here and there.”

short.vo: So, too soon? Going on would have cost India almost nothing, and gained almost nothing. The match slipped away between over seventy-three and ninety-four.

scene.sub: Going on would have cost India almost nothing, and gained almost nothing.

short.vo: Was the handshake right? Comment one, too soon. Two, right call. Three, it was the chances.

short.description:
India vs New Zealand, 1st Test day five: did Shubman Gill quit too soon? A simulation of the last 15 overs (New Zealand 239 for 5, five wickets needed): India's chance of a win was about 4 in 1,000, and what the three missed chances around Daryl Mitchell were worth: 17 to 22 points of win probability each. The Day 5 pitch at the end, the Basin Reserve in the Test archive, and who bowled the last 15 overs. A model, not a prediction. Comment 1 too soon, 2 right call, 3 it was the chances. Full breakdown on the channel.
